Based in the Bahamas, he became a director and majority shareholder of Bottled Science, the company behind Skinade, a brand of drinks marketed for skin care.

Based in the Bahamas, he became a director and majority shareholder of Bottled Science, the company behind Skinade, a brand of drinks marketed for skin care.

long_biography.plain_text:
As president of Masterfoods, Richard Raper explained the commercial logic behind its agreement to buy Royal Canin: the companies reached pet owners through different channels. Masterfoods specialised in supermarket distribution, while Royal Canin sold nutrition-focused products through specialist outlets. The deal envisaged retaining Royal Canin's management team and reinvesting its cash flow in the business.

Raper also helped develop a drink formulation combining collagen and vitamin C. He was one of four named inventors, alongside Piers Raper, Christiaan Haig and Obi Ejifor, on the American patent granted in 2019. The inventors assigned the patent rights to Bottled Science.

confidence.reason: Full acquisition announcement and primary patent metadata/assignment history support strategy and named technical contribution; no efficacy claim is made.
